title: Monolayer MoS2 (three-band model): shift current and SHG
summary: The three-band d-orbital model of the MX2 monolayers (Liu et al. 2013, GGA parameters, with spin-orbit coupling) for MoS2: shift current, injection currents and second-harmonic susceptibility of the sheet (D3h: yyy = -yxx = -xxy, xxx = 0). No DFT run.

steps.label: Shift current, injection currents and SHG of MoS2
